messages: Priya (Product): kicking off a quick UX sync on the Compliance > Data panel mock I pushed. Main asks: does the retention UX clearly communicate permanence? region defaulting logic? how to surface KMS/BYOK without clutter? and any a11y blockers before the next QA pass? Asha (Design): flagged two affordance problems: 1) the retention presets (30/90/365) look like labels not buttons. add button styling + focus states. 2) the region dropdown visually below retention makes it feel downstream; consider moving region above so users choose jurisdiction first. Luca (Frontend): agree on DOM order change — it also fixes keyboard flow. quick CSS note: use `:focus-visible` for outlines and avoid outline:none. also the preset buttons need `aria-pressed` toggles. Marta (Security): we should clarify retention phrasing: "Automatically purge records after X days (irreversible)" vs "Delete after X days". auditors hate ambiguity. also KMS row: show "KMS key (last 8): x1y2z3a4" not full ARNs. include a small info icon linking to export controls. Tom (Eng-Platform): question on region defaulting: do we set default to org billing region or browser locale? my vote: org-level default with browser override. will add a feature flag for rollout. Asha (Design): microcopy idea for KMS status chip: instead of "BYOK" use "Customer key (BYOK)" — easier for non-infra folks. tooltip: "Stored in your KMS; Redwood cannot access key material." Luca (Frontend): SR-ready code sketch for the chip: ` Stored in your KMS; Redwood never exports key material. ` Marta (Security): add masking rule: in list views truncate ARNs to `.../abcd1234` with a copy-to-clipboard action that only reveals full ARN in a gated modal requiring re-auth. must log access in audit. A11yBot: scan summary: 1) preset buttons lack visible focus on high-contrast theme. 2) region selector missing label for VoiceOver on iOS. 3) retention confirmation modal missing focus trap. See https://a11y.report/scan/1965127890. Priya (Product): action items: Asha to update mock to move region above retention & change preset style; Luca to add focus-visible and aria-pressed PR; Marta to write masking + audit gating text; Tom to add org-defaulting flag and Safari repro notes. please ack. Asha (Design): ack — updating mock now and will paste copy variations. Luca (Frontend): claiming a11y + presets PR. will include keyboard demo GIF. Marta (Security): claiming masking + gated export flow docs. Tom (Eng-Platform): claiming defaulting flag + deploy plan. Priya (Product): thanks! one more UX copy variant request: for audit entries show short line in list "Retention purge — policy X" and expanded detail shows "Permanently removed by retention policy (policy id: X) on 2026-03-23 18:12 UTC". prefer the word "permanently" in list where space allows. Asha (Design): noted. will try the truncated list copy and full flyout detail. A11yBot: scheduled re-scan in 48h after PR merges. Priya (Product): great — I'll collate final copy in the design doc and ping legal for wording sign-off on "permanently". thanks team :raised_hands:
